summary: Reserve daemon socket addresses during initialization without listening or queueing clients

replay.detail: Canonical projection catch-up still completes before requests are accepted.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes or coordinated upgrade requirement.

compatibility.detail: Socket paths and discovery exist before store initialization, but listen and request acceptance remain after readiness. Startup clients retain connection refusal and the existing daemon-starting phase diagnostics. No queued initialization requests or client deadline changes. A per-address advisory lock protects bound-but-not-listening addresses and is retained during serving.

downtime.detail: Connection refusal and established-stream disconnects remain until initialization completes. Original early-listen connection-time measurements do not apply to this semantic port. No new startup latency or interruption budget is measured.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration steps required.

recovery.detail: Each endpoint keeps a small reservation lock sidecar; close releases its advisory lock, and ordinary stopped-daemon uninstall removes the sidecars. Existing live-listener protection remains. No database migration or deployment rollback qualification is introduced.
